question: Which of the following is an ore of thorium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monazite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Monazite** is an important ore of thorium.
 
• It is a reddish-brown phosphate mineral that contains rare earth metals, including thorium.
 
• Monazite is primarily found in beach sands in India, Brazil, Australia, and South Africa.
 
• It is extracted and processed to obtain thorium, which is used as a nuclear fuel and in various industrial applications.
 
• Thorium extracted from monazite has potential applications in nuclear reactors as a cleaner and safer alternative to uranium.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Torbernite** and **Pitchblende** are ores of uranium, not thorium.
 
• **Carnotite** is also an ore of uranium and vanadium.
 
• Monazite's thorium content varies, but it can be as high as 12% thorium oxide (ThO₂).
 
• The extraction of thorium from monazite involves several steps, including crushing, grinding, and chemical processing.
 
• Thorium is being researched as a potential fuel for future nuclear reactors due to its abundance and safety benefits over uranium.
